body:
## Goal

Replace the expanded implementation in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/495 with the lean scope originally intended by https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/452: terminal PR-note finalization and best-effort cleanup within the existing single-job orchestrator.

## Context

PR #495 grew from a focused final-comment change into a 24-file planner/write-job split with planner-response artifacts, session persistence, progress-publishing CLIs, and cross-job recovery machinery. The maintainer explicitly wants that expansion removed.

The existing architecture already runs planning and deterministic handoff in one job, and `orchestrate-handoff.ts` already owns terminal comments. Existing helpers can merge into a progress comment, upsert a marker-bearing PR comment, and minimize trusted generated comments.

## Acceptance criteria

- Retain the existing single orchestration job and its existing permission model.
- Implement terminal PR-note finalization as a focused extension of the existing handoff CLI.
- For a validated terminal `stop`, publish one concise note containing the planner summary, source outcome, round, reason, and a human requester mention when applicable.
- Keep the existing `sepo-agent-orchestrate-stop` marker; do not add legacy-marker migration.
- Merge the finalized result into the current run's progress comment when available; otherwise update or create the marker-bearing note without duplicates.
- On exact successful terminal outcomes only, best-effort collapse older trusted, same-agent PR conversation artifacts while keeping the finalized note visible.
- Never perform cleanup for blocked, clarification, failed, malformed-planner, or other non-success outcomes.
- Cleanup failures remain non-fatal and do not prevent final-note publication.
- Remove the planner/write-job split, planner-response artifacts, session-persistence changes, new progress-publishing CLIs, cross-job duration/recovery machinery, and formal review-object cleanup introduced by the expanded implementation.
- Add focused regression coverage for requester tagging, marker upsert and progress-note reuse, terminal-state eligibility, cleanup exclusions, and non-fatal cleanup failures.
- Update only directly relevant documentation and leave release notes unchanged.

---

Requested via issue_comment at https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/495
